manager.tenantsHint: Every workspace on the platform. This is the one list the tenant filter is deliberately off for.
manager.name: Name
manager.membersHint: Opening one starts a recorded support session in the tenant application.
manager.suspendConfirm: Suspend "{name}"? Everyone in that workspace is signed out and locked out.
manager.impersonateConfirm: Open a support session as {email}? It is recorded, limited, and expires in 15 minutes.
manager.auditHint: Across every tenant, with impersonated actions attributed to the operator who performed them.
manager.flagsHint: Platform defaults, and the per-tenant overrides that sit on top of them.
manager.applyToHint: Paste a tenant id from its page. An override needs a workspace to apply to.
manager.pickTenantFirst: Name a tenant first - an override has to apply to one.
manager.workersHint: Everything that happens after a response goes through these queues.
manager.failedHint: Anything here has exhausted its retries and is waiting for a person.
manager.rateLimited: Too many attempts. This account reaches every tenant, so the limit is deliberately tight - wait and try again.
manager.loginNotice: Operator sessions do not persist across a reload, and expire after 15 minutes.
manager.loginSubtitle: Sign in with a platform operator account.
manager.error.forbidden.title: No permission
manager.error.forbidden.description: This part of the console is reserved to a super operator.
manager.error.notFound.title: Page not found
manager.error.notFound.description: This address does not lead anywhere in the console.
manager.error.failed.title: Something went wrong
manager.error.failed.description: The page could not be shown. Try again in a moment; if it keeps happening, quote the reference below.
manager.operatorsHint: Who can sign in to this console. Created with `openenu manager create`.
manager.consultantsHint: Who serves which client. Assign one on the client's page.
manager.tenantCreateHint: The slug is its short name in addresses and commands: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.
manager.memberAddHint: A new person gets an account; someone who has one joins with it. They gain access to this client's data, and it goes on the trail. Needs a super operator.
manager.memberExisted: They already had an account and can sign in with it.
manager.memberLinkHint: Copy it now and pass it on: it is shown only once, works once and expires in 7 days.
